product: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) is scheduled for retirement
tagline: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) will be retired on November 5, 2026.
what_it_does: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) will be retired on November 5, 2026. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the recommended replacement. This page describes the model maintenance policy for the Foundation Model APIs pay per token, Foundation Model APIs provisioned throughput, Batch Inference with ai query, and Foundation Model Fine tuning offerings.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) will be retired on November 5, 2026. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the recommended replacement.
